# kcore_operator (Resource)

RBAC operator and optional client certificate (`kctl operator add`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_operator" "ci" {
  name       = "ci"
  roles      = ["vm-admin"]
  issue_cert = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `issue_cert` (Boolean)
- `roles` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `cert_pem` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_pem` (String, Sensitive)
